titles.title: My Lifelong Wish Is Scorched Rice

description:
I made up my mind: confess to my long-time crush, then finally give up on him. Right after I lose weight, that is! Of all things, why did Lee Su-ho’s ideal type have to be “someone slender and pretty”? At last, just 5 kg left until my target weight.

*“Kang Ji-goo... you’re doing **what**?”*

...Except his reaction is completely unhinged.

*“Kang Ji-goo, don’t push it. If things go sideways, I’m personally hunting down whatever gay bastard this is.”  
“Lee Su-ho, I think you’ve lost your mind a little.”  
“Just a little? You really think I’ve only lost it **a little**?”*

Will Kang Ji-goo ever manage to confess to Lee Su-ho, a borderline germaphobe who detests gay guys? *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
